84:7.text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

84:8.text: He will be judged with an easy account

84:9.text: And return to his people in happiness.

84:15.text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

84:21.text: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate

84:22.text: But those who have disbelieved deny,

84:23.text: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

84:24.text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

84:25.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
